'''Winsafra WCYJLTSAON/TAHN :P''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 FirstMove Winsafra DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Why Can't You Just Leave The Sith Alone On Naboo? They Ain't Hurting Nobody! :P

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

First of all, get the naboo, then coruscant, then cloud city docking bays out. Second, Get somebody with a saber to one of the generator sites TURN 1!!!!! Back them up second turn at the latest! Use Maul strikes if you got a guy and no saber, or if you didn't get any characters, draw up to get someone for second turn. As soon as the lightside draws a huge hand, search for evader/monnok and use monnok to send all but 8 back to their used pile. keep doing this as many times as you can, it gets really annoying. or if you think they've got alotta good stuff in their hand, use the lost part or monnok. don't forget, if you use the used part, as soon as you recycle your used pile, you can pull it out again! Basically, you wanna drain as fast as you can for as much as you can to hurt your opponent early on. If you want, try an throw in a 4th maul, maybe take out a tarkin or something, cause he'll hurt, draining for 4 second turn! :P

Well, good luck, hope somebody uses this an has as much fun as i do wit this deck :)
